title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Three From Abdeen Family North of Khan Younis
detail: An Israeli drone strike north of Khan Younis, southern Gaza, killed three members of the Abdeen family on Friday morning, August 28, 2026. The strike was part of a wave of Israeli attacks across Gaza that day that killed at least 5 Palestinians, occurring despite the U.S.-brokered ceasefire in place since October 2025. The killings came as Gaza faces severe food insecurity, with 46% of surveyed residents reporting going to bed hungry in the previous month.

title: Israeli Strikes Kill Two More in Gaza City's Sabra and Mashahra Areas; IDF Claims Hamas, PIJ Commanders Killed
detail: A separate Israeli drone missile attack in the Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City killed Hassan al-Deiri on August 28, 2026, and another strike on a tent in the Mashahra area east of Gaza City killed one more Palestinian, with several others wounded in both incidents. The IDF said it killed Qais Bitawi, whom it identified as a 'Hamas operative,' and claimed to have killed 'two Palestinian commanders — one with Hamas and one with Palestinian Islamic Jihad' in separate Thursday attacks on Gaza City, though it did not provide evidence for the claims. Israeli forces also carried out a wide-scale demolition operation in areas under its control southeast of Gaza City the same day.
